title: Rei's Cosmetics and Gadgets
description: Bored of the usual Minecraft items? With this Datapack you will have much more fun!
body:
# Rei's Cosmetics and Gadgets:

Tired of the same old Armors and Tools? Let's spice things up with some new items!

**1. Wearable Banners**
![A Minecraft screenshot of an omnious banner being worn by a player](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81c1e17d4301278682f7b1aa25da271765b5c728.png)
![a second minecraft screenshot of a banner (pink) being worn by a player](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/609ca476c4c95a26c462631b664007909fe409f0.png)
![a screenshot of the recipe of wearable banners (leather cap + any banner)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f15fa6297a0ec9d5adbb917b6dc52c1fe6202b1.png)
WARNING: once a banner is transformed into a wearable banner it can't be modfied anymore.

**2. A Unicorn Horn!**
![a minevraft screenshot with a player wearing an end rod as a unicorn horn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a58da8e97ca8757694b3f0041a09ab0b64c3b464.png)
![a screenshot of the recipe of the unicorn hor: red, orange, yellow, green, light blue, blue, purple, pink dye + an end rod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bf81c68cfdd8c021222fc799560f140598cb9fd.png)

**3. Custom Totems**
![a screenshot of a custom totem being used (allay variant)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a32e48cf5c9d4be110f77c984dc4908ff6aabd1c.png)
![one of the recipes of the custom totems, which look like spawn eggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a5434df969e13159b5f831b43018abf6cb3784c.png)

All Totems' recipes are:
- Totem + Amethyst Shard = Allay of Undying
- Totem + Sweet Berries = Fox of Undying
- Totem + Glow Berries = Axolotl of Undying
- Totem + Cod = Cat of Undying
- Totem + Salmon = Ocelot of Undying
- Totem + Bamboo = Panda of Undying
- Totem + Wheat Seeds = Parrot of Undying
- Totem + Snowball = Snow Golem of Undying
- Totem + Coal = Bat of Undying
- Totem + Bone = Wolf of Undying
- Totem + Carrot = Rabbit of Undying
- Totem + Honeycomb/Honey Bottle = Bee of Undying
- Totem + Armadillo Scute = Guess What? Armadillo of Undying

**4. A Diving Helmet**
![the screenshot of a player wearing a diving helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9707b5cbab9104b131c838bdfcce73938697c841.png)
![a screenshot of the recipe of the diving helmet (a turtle helmet + four pieces of glass around it)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc49139363b443ca2e23ff280918ddfdcd53cbbc.png)

**5. A Confetti Shooter**
![A Minecraft Screenshot of Confetti being shot, using the same particles as the totems of undying](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6731fea6622e97334a7e35f529df4fe881116d18.png)
![A second screenshot of confetti being shot, now the confetti are slowly falling on the ground](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e953fc758b531b905cb75d59e6b36a5ec947f5b.png)
![a screenshot of the recipe of confetti shooters (paper + glowstone powder)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99e4c92055f1369e7062eb03b17fe62e54b724e2.png)

**6. Bell and Anvil Sound Effects**
![a screenshot of the recipe of the anvil sound effect (an anvil + a goat horn)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d64acd03f1f67fc17523ac8df644a8551e9cf72b.png)
![a screenshot of the recipe of the bell sound effect (a bell + a goat horn)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7f20147a4c51ef593c6a8c0b72533e649cbb3e7.png)
